- new_walker: step change in gait, then stable (needs a 're-baseline' note)
- busy_visit_day: one day of high activity
- single_bad_night
- sensor_off: wear time drops, so the card should say 'Not enough data'
- device_swap: accelerometer bias offset, so the card should show a calibration flag

Per-event HR: hr_base + rise x (1 - e^(-t/4)) then recovery with tau = settle/3, Gaussian noise sd 3 bpm, sampled every 5 s.

Honesty measures:
- every row has source='synthetic' (CHECK constraint)
- display names like 'Synthetic resident B-04'
- ground truth goes in sim.truth (resident_id, scenario, onset_day, expected_tier, is_counterexample), which the rule engine never reads

GET /senior/sim/report returns:
- detection per scenario
- days from onset to first Watch/Nurse tier
- false 'Nurse review' cards per 100 stable resident-days
- counter-example suppression rate

Label it on screen: 'Lead times reflect our scripted slopes, not clinical evidence.' Optionally generate one resident-day of raw 50 Hz IMU (4.32 M rows) to show hypertable ingest honestly.

findings.topic: Tiger Data schema and SQL for senior mode (hypertables, continuous aggregates, rolling baselines)
findings.detail:
Docs support for each piece:
- CREATE TABLE ... WITH (tsdb.hypertable, tsdb.segmentby='...') is the current way to create a hypertable. The partition column defaults to the first timestamp column (https://www.tigerdata.com/docs/use-timescale/latest/hypertables/hypertable-crud).
- Continuous aggregates support all PostgreSQL aggregates, including ordered-set aggregates, from TimescaleDB 2.7 (https://www.tigerdata.com/docs/use-timescale/latest/continuous-aggregates/about-continuous-aggregates).
- Tiger Cloud includes all hyperfunctions. percentile_agg(value) works inside a continuous aggregate, and approx_percentile(p, rollup(agg)) combines intermediate aggregates (https://www.tigerdata.com/docs/api/latest/hyperfunctions/percentile-approximation/uddsketch/).
- rolling(ss StatsSummary1D) RETURNS StatsSummary1D, used in a window such as OVER (ORDER BY bucket RANGE '1 day' PRECEDING) (https://www.tigerdata.com/docs/reference/toolkit/statistical-and-regression-analysis/stats_agg-one-variable/rolling).
- num_vals(summary StatsSummary1D) RETURNS BIGINT (https://www.tigerdata.com/docs/reference/toolkit/statistical-and-regression-analysis/stats_agg-one-variable/num_vals).
- add_continuous_aggregate_policy(view, start_offset, end_offset, schedule_interval) (https://www.tigerdata.com/docs/api/latest/continuous-aggregates/add_continuous_aggregate_policy).

findings.topic: FastAPI endpoints for senior mode (minimal set)
findings.detail:
Each endpoint maps to a requirement in the findings above:
- Explainable card: the card design and points findings.
- Feedback loop: the Rantz RCT found nurses relied on short emails, so capture their response on the card (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5679074).
- Tiered push: AHRQ's advice to interrupt only for the most severe alerts (https://psnet.ahrq.gov/primer/alert-fatigue).
findings.recommendation:
Endpoints:
- POST /senior/sim/generate {n_residents, n_days, seed}: writes synthetic rows plus sim.truth.
- POST /senior/ingest/stand-event: from bridge.py with StsEvent plus computed features; source='device'; resident_id of the demo resident.
- POST /senior/ingest/hr: batches of {ts, bpm} from the Web Bluetooth page.
- POST /senior/evaluate?as_of=: runs score_resident for all residents and writes alert_card rows.
- GET /senior/residents: list with tier and points.
- GET /senior/residents/{resident_id}/card?as_of=
- GET /senior/residents/{resident_id}/trend?metric=hr_settle_s&days=42
- POST /senior/cards/{card_id}/narrative (Vultr)
- POST /senior/cards/{card_id}/ack {by, outcome: 'assessed_no_change'|'vitals_taken'|'escalated', note}
- GET /senior/sim/report

Only tier='nurse_review_today' sends a Telegram message. Reuse the KAZE bot, with a separate chat for staff.

bottom_line:
Senior mode is only defensible as a flag that says "this resident's pattern has changed from her usual", which a nurse then reviews. It is not a fall or illness predictor.

**Build it this way:**
- **Data:** synthetic multi-day histories, labelled as synthetic everywhere, plus one live stand-up demo. A judge stands up wearing the device and the event joins a synthetic resident's history.
- **Detecting standing up:** accelerometer only, using a lower-back/head method (1.3 Hz vertical-acceleration filter, 4 s integration, 20–60 cm height gate). Optionally confirm with the lab's barometer at roughly 12 Pa per metre. Wrist placement is unvalidated, and in daily life expect recall around 61%, not the lab's 95%+.
- **Heart rate:** the Apple Watch reports about every 5 s at best, HeartCast doesn't document its broadcast rate, and battery in workout mode lasts up to about 10 h. So heart rate can only be a coarse response measured around detected stand-ups. Treat changes under 11 bpm as noise (the published minimum detectable change at 30 s is 10.9 bpm).

**Change the outline:**
- **Card wording:** "heart rate alone cannot show blood pressure; nurse to consider orthostatic vitals per protocol".
- **Remove:**
  - the 48–72 h early-warning claim (the evidence is weeks-scale, camera-based and preliminary, and the follow-up RCT showed no fall reduction);
  - POTS, a young-adult condition that needs a blood-pressure check;
  - UTI/sepsis/delirium/over-sedation wording;
  - the CNA orthostatic-vitals action;
  - skin temperature. The lab sensor measures air/board temperature to ±1 °C, so drop it or show chart temperature as context only.
- **Scoring:** replace the opaque 0–100 score with NEWS2-style points per rule. Show this period vs her usual, event counts, data quality and limits on the card. Only "Nurse review today" should push a notification.
- **AI:** let the LLM (Vultr, OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.vultrinference.com/v1) only rewrite the rule JSON into a 2-sentence handoff, with checks on numbers and blocked terms.
- **Stop and Watch:** don't embed the form; its licence forbids putting it in software without Florida Atlantic University's permission.

**Data stack and timeline:** run the generator (scripted declines plus counter-examples, separate ground-truth table, evaluation report) on Tiger hypertables. Use a continuous aggregate with `stats_agg`/`percentile_agg` and the `rolling()` window queries given above. This fits in about 12–14 hours of the remaining 30 without touching the KAZE core.
